articles.title: Jhunjhunwala's firm, Madhu Kela among I-Pru AMC's pre IPO investors
articles.summary: ICICI Prudential Asset Management successfully completed a pre-IPO share sale, raising approximately Rs 4,900 crore. The significant funding came from 26 diverse investors, including prominent foreign and domestic institutions and family offices. This substantial investment underscores robust market confidence in the company's prospects and the broader Indian financial sector, signalling strong investor appetite ahead of its potential public listing.
